title: Upstream config syntax error mistaken for the front-end host config
diagnosis: The same /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf path exists in both containers. An error emitted by edge-victim-app names its own file, not the front-end host file returned by read_config. Restart retains that damaged layer. Restoring the healthy front-end config cannot repair the upstream.
required_evidence: The syntax error comes from docker_logs(name=edge-victim-app), not edge-victim.
The failing file belongs to the upstream writable layer; it is not an external mount.
After one upstream restart, /api/ still fails; leave the serving front end running.
scope: Only this project's stateless edge-victim and edge-victim-app definitions. Do not apply a rebuild to a stateful or unrelated production container. Existing tool and reviewer checks still apply.

historical_failure.limitation: Old Nano runs and old guards; current Bolt failure rate has not been measured.

title: Front-end main nginx.conf changed: worker_connections are not enough
diagnosis: A valid but damaged /etc/nginx/nginx.conf in the front-end writable layer can exhaust worker connections. This is outside the host-mounted site configuration. Restoring default.conf does not repair it; restarting keeps the changed main config. The front-end must have measured image-file changes before rebuilding.
required_evidence: The complaint comes from the front end and /api/ fails.
docker_logs layer-change note identifies /etc/nginx/nginx.conf as changed from the known-good state.
A running-container inspection confirms the implausible worker_connections setting; ordinary production load or an intentional limit is not proof of corruption.
scope: Only this project's stateless edge-victim and edge-victim-app definitions. Do not apply a rebuild to a stateful or unrelated production container. Existing tool and reviewer checks still apply.

historical_failure.limitation: The old guard rejected changed image files. Current code permits measured changes; Bolt unmeasured.

title: Front-end cannot open an image-owned nginx include file
diagnosis: A main-config include such as mime.types is missing from the front-end writable layer. It is not the host-mounted default.conf. A site-config restore leaves this missing include unresolved.
required_evidence: The front-end log names open() failure for an image-owned path outside /etc/nginx/conf.d.
The layer-change note confirms that path is deleted or changed, not a missing externally mounted file.
The failed restart is recorded for edge-victim and subsequent /api/ health still fails.

title: Upstream static-file permission failure survives restart
diagnosis: An upstream static file has become unreadable to nginx workers in this stateless container's writable layer. A local open/stat permission error plus an HTTP 403 is different from an authentication failure, a missing index page or front-end access policy. Restart does not reset file permissions.
required_evidence: /api/ returns 403 and the upstream's own log names a static-file open/stat permission error.
The file is in the project's upstream writable layer, not a mounted document root or secret.
The ownership/mode evidence agrees with the file-access failure and restart did not recover /api/.
scope: Only this project's stateless edge-victim and edge-victim-app definitions. Do not apply a rebuild to a stateful or unrelated production container. Existing tool and reviewer checks still apply.
